title: Separate push validation from Pages deployment

expectation.example: A failed verify or acceptance check should be visible as a push/PR validation failure, while Pages deployment should only run for a successful main validation.
expectation.expected: Validate runs full verify and acceptance checks on push/PR; Deploy Pages consumes successful main validation, performs a lightweight current-version check, builds, and deploys.
expectation.unchanged: No product code, scheduling rule, acceptance semantics, or manual Pages dispatch behavior changes.
expectation.fallback: If validation fails or its result is not a successful main push, Pages deployment must not run.

reproduction.reason: The previous workflow combined full verify, acceptance, build, and deployment in one Pages build job; the changed workflow separates those stages.

evidence.summary: Workflow inspection records the old responsibility split and the new triggers/conditions.

normalPath.reason: The focused architecture tests confirm full verification is attached to validate.yml and the deploy workflow uses the successful main validation condition.

evidence.summary: Focused CI workflow tests passed as part of the full verify run.

alternatePath.reason: The workflow keeps workflow_dispatch available and the deploy condition explicitly permits that manual path.

evidence.summary: Static workflow inspection confirms manual trigger handling.

postProcessing.reason: The deploy job performs the current-version fingerprint check before the production build and artifact upload; full verify is no longer repeated there.

evidence.summary: Workflow inspection confirms fingerprint-before-build ordering and no full verify in deploy.

finalGuard.reason: The deploy workflow requires a successful Validate workflow run from a push to main; the final lightweight fingerprint check remains before publishing.

evidence.summary: Workflow condition and final fingerprint guard are recorded and checked.

unchanged.reason: The full repository verification passed and the diff is limited to workflows, the workflow architecture test, history, and acceptance material.

evidence.summary: Typecheck, all functional tests, performance tests, and production build passed.

finalArtifact.reason: The final workflow files are present, parseable, and covered by the focused architecture tests; actual GitHub-hosted execution remains an external follow-up.

evidence.summary: Final workflow file paths, triggers, conditions, and YAML parse result are recorded.

answers.originalFailure: The old Pages workflow reported a failed verify or acceptance check as a deployment failure because those checks lived in the deployment build job.
answers.laterChanges: Full verify and acceptance now run in Validate on push/PR; Pages waits for successful main validation, then runs only a fingerprint check and build.
answers.finalArtifact: The final artifacts are .github/workflows/validate.yml and the updated .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml, with the current source fingerprint recorded above.

review.missedScope: A workflow split can accidentally allow deployment without successful validation or break manual dispatch; both paths were explicitly checked.
review.rootCause: The previous workflow mixed two responsibilities, so the GitHub UI surfaced a validation refusal as a deployment failure.
review.earlyDetection: For future release changes, inspect triggers, success dependency, checkout SHA, pre-publish guard, and manual dispatch separately, then run the architecture workflow test and full verify before delivery.
